definition: to leave something open to weather
description: On a sunny stone square in an old town, a black cloth comes off a life-size statue of clear ice standing on a stone plinth, and a broken ice hand lies in a puddle on the ground. A young man in a flat cap, white shirt and black waistcoat holds the black cloth and grins beside the shiny, dripping ice figure. The ice melts in the hot sun and water runs down onto the plinth. Tourists in summer clothes watch, and cafe tables stand under tall shuttered buildings.

taps.phrase: to melt in the hot sun

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er grinst die schmelzende Statue an.
de.question: Was macht der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está sonriendo ampliamente a la estatua que se derrite.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el joven?

fr.answer: Il sourit à la statue qui fond.
fr.question: Que fait le jeune homme ?
